items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: I first met Bobby Hutcherson when Terry Trotter, the pianist, took me over to Bobby’s house to play with Bobby and him and Herbie Lewis the bass player.

ctx.x: Yeah. I first met Bobby Hutcherson when Terry Trotter, the pianist, took me over to Bobby’s house to play with Bobby and him and Herbie Lewis the bass player. And they were a year older than me. And the first thing Bobby said to me after, “Do you have any marijuana” was, “Can you play fast?” I said, “I don’t know, let’s find out.” So they put “From This Moment on” way, way up. And, you know, I guess I did okay. I really didn’t

know how to play the drums. I had no technique at all, but I could hear and I could follow music and I could play music in other words, I just didn’t have a solid technique on the drums or any technique on the drums.
